title: Repair a broken test suite
description: `src/minStack.ts` is correct (read its doc comment), but `test/minStack.test.ts` is broken: it does not compile and several assertions contradict the documented behaviour. Repair the test file so that it compiles under `strict`, passes against the correct implementation, and still genuinely tests it: it will also be run against several subtly broken versions of `MinStack`, all of which it must detect. Keep (and where useful add to) the coverage; do not just delete assertions. At least 6 tests are required. Do not edit the implementation.

mutants.description: min() is stale after pop (the min stack is never popped)
pop() on an empty stack throws
duplicate minimums are lost (push uses < instead of <=)
clear() does not reset the minimums
